abstract.#text: The legendary entrepreneur and online gaming pioneer, creator of the Ultima series and the forthcoming Shroud of Avatar, and private space travel advocate examines the importance of adventure and curiosity in his life in this inspiring memoir, complete with interactive tie-ins, puzzles, tricks, and secret codes.
